branches.suggestion: The hallway's full of wet things! Whose umbrella is this? The pink one.
branches.suggestionFa: راهرو پر از وسایل خیسه! این چتر مال کیه؟ صورتیه.

branches.suggestion: Yes, it's Nicola's. And these wellies? The big green ones. Are they yours?
branches.suggestionFa: آره، مال نیکولاست. و این چکمه‌ها؟ سبزهای بزرگ. مال توئه؟

branches.suggestion: Ryan's are muddy. These are clean. Where are your wellies, then?
branches.suggestionFa: مال رایان گلیه. اینا تمیزن. پس چکمه‌های تو کجان؟

branches.suggestion: No wellies? In London? You need some! Ah, these are George's.
branches.suggestionFa: چکمه نداری؟ تو لندن؟ لازم داری! آه، اینا مال جورجه.

branches.suggestion: Not anymore. He doesn't go out in the rain now, with his heart. Borrow them!
branches.suggestionFa: دیگه نه. با این قلبش الان زیر بارون نمیره بیرون. قرضشون بگیر!

r6.speaker: learner
r6.text: Thank you. Are they my size?

branches.suggestion: Try them on. And whose coat is this on the floor? It's soaking!
branches.suggestionFa: امتحانشون کن. و این کت رو زمین مال کیه؟ خیس آبه!

branches.suggestion: Hang it on the hook, please! Everyone, wet things on the hooks, boots on the mat!
branches.suggestionFa: لطفاً آویزونش کن رو قلاب! همه، وسایل خیس رو قلاب، چکمه‌ها رو پادری!

branches.suggestion: By the door. Thank you! Honestly, this hallway is like a swimming pool. I need a coffee.
branches.suggestionFa: کنار در. ممنون! راستی این راهرو شبیه استخر شده. یه قهوه لازم دارم.
